info.name: Fondeka Business API v1 — Sandbox
info.description: Generated from the merchant contract. Set apiKey locally, businessId and a unique intent. Keep intent on retries. Async payments need polling; running the collection once does not wait for completion. Synthetic fixtures only.

exec: const key=pm.variables.get("apiKey") || "";
if (!key.startsWith("fdk_biz_test_")) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error("This example collection accepts sandbox keys only."); }

if (!pm.variables.get("intent") || pm.variables.get("intent")==="CHANGE_ME_ONCE_PER_LOGICAL_RUN") { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error("Set intent to a unique value; keep it unchanged on retries."); }

request.description: LIVE keys read the owning account's real fiat wallets; SANDBOX keys read isolated virtual wallets. Businesses under the same account share balances within their environment. An absent wallet queried by currency has zero balance.

exec: pm.test("HTTP response includes support request ID", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Request-Id")).to.be.a("string"));
if (pm.response.code === 202) { const body=pm.response.json(); if (body.reference) pm.collectionVariables.set("reference",body.reference); }

request.description: SANDBOX only. Add virtual funds synchronously. Maximum 1,000,000 per call and 100 new top-ups per account per UTC day. Replaying an existing identical intent does not consume another quota slot. No provider or real wallet is used.

exec: pm.test("HTTP response includes support request ID", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Request-Id")).to.be.a("string"));

request.description: Accept an asynchronous mobile-money or crypto collection. Amount and currency refer to fiat settlement, including crypto. Credit the account wallet only after confirmation. request.description: Read the current payment state using its opaque reference and a key belonging to the same Business and environment. Crypto payment instructions may initially be null while invoice creation is queued. Poll with backoff until instructions or a terminal result are available. FAILED/CANCELED do not imply a refund; inspect refunded.

exec: pm.test("HTTP response includes support request ID", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Request-Id")).to.be.a("string"));

request.description: Accept an asynchronous mobile-money or crypto payout. Reserve/debit the account fiat wallet gross amount including fees at acceptance. Crypto token amounts are quoted server-side. A completed payout does not debit again. Unknown or manual-review outcomes keep funds reserved; do not submit a replacement payment while investigating.

item.name: Preview a sandbox currency conversion — convert

request.description: SANDBOX only. Return QUOTED with no conversion id. Uses configurable synthetic FX fixtures and zero fees. A quote does not reserve funds or lock a rate. Source and target currencies must differ and have configured fixture rates.

exec: pm.test("HTTP response includes support request ID", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Request-Id")).to.be.a("string"));
if (pm.response.code === 202) { const body=pm.response.json(); if (body.reference) pm.collectionVariables.set("reference",body.reference); }

request.description: SANDBOX only. Atomically debit source and credit target using current synthetic rates. Return COMPLETED with a conversion id and both balances. Idempotent across this account's Businesses/keys; conflicting reuse returns 409. No real money, provider call or payment webhook is involved.

exec: pm.test("HTTP response includes support request ID", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("X-Request-Id")).to.be.a("string"));
if (pm.response.code === 202) { const body=pm.response.json(); if (body.reference) pm.collectionVariables.set("reference",body.reference); }

request.description: SANDBOX only. Read append-only account wallet entries, newest sequence first. Includes top-ups, payment credits, payout debits/refunds and conversion entries. LIVE credentials are rejected with 403.
